about.title: About us
about.subtitle: IPEC Energy
about.description1: IPEC Energy is an independent research and business intelligence company that turns data into strategic decisions. We provide clients with trusted analytics and actionable insights to help them confidently make key decisions in the oil, gas and mining industries.
about.description2: IPEC Energy brings together world-class experts with experience from Halliburton, Schlumberger, leading investment banks, as well as Big Three and Big Four consulting firms.
about.description3: We work at the intersection of engineering, economics and finance, law and IT, offering an integrated approach to the most complex business problems. Our solutions are based on deep expertise and result-oriented.
